backgroundColor.description:
Canvas background, as `#RRGGBB`. Defaults to the SDS theme's base
background, so the canvas follows the surrounding page in both modes.

showAxes.description: Show the orientation axes widget and the reset-camera button.

showLegend.description: Show the stats and color scale legend overlaid on the viewer.

sequenceViewerBackgroundColor.description:
Sequence panel background, as any CSS color. Defaults to the SDS theme's
primary surface, so the panel follows the surrounding page in both modes.

showSequenceViewer.description: Show the sequence panel pinned along the bottom of the viewer.

stats.description:
Up to three whole-structure stats shown along the bottom. A null entry
reserves its column without rendering anything, so the columns never shift
as values come and go.

pdb.description: Structure to render, as raw PDB text.

plddt.description:
Per-residue pLDDT confidence on a 0-1 scale, ordered by residue. When
supplied the structure is colored by pLDDT unless `residueOverlay` takes
over.

residueOverlay.description: Per-residue values that override pLDDT coloring while set.

selectedResidue.description:
0-based index of the selected residue, or null when none is selected.
Controlled: selecting a residue zooms the camera in on it, and clearing the
selection zooms back out to the default view.

onResidueHover.description:
Called as the pointer moves over residues, and with `null` when it leaves
the structure.

onSelectionClear.description: Called when the user clicks empty space, clearing the selection.

values.description: 0-based residue index to value. Residues absent from the map read as 0, so they render in the neutral gray rather than at the bottom of the scale.

max.description: The value mapped to the top of the color scale.

min.description: Values at or below this render in a neutral gray rather than on the scale.

colorScale.description: Scale used to color residues and to draw the legend.

tooltip.description: Help tooltip attached to the legend caption.

readoutLabel.description: Label for the per-residue readout that replaces a stat slot on hover.

value.description: The stat's value, already formatted for display.
